Compiled first finite-horizon RL foundation leaf. The Lean-facing MDP stores a finite horizon, finite state/action types, a Mathlib Markov transition kernel, and a measurable deterministic Real reward. It defines the one-step continuation integral and Bellman action value, proves both state-action surfaces measurable from a measurable continuation value, and identifies the zero-continuation Bellman value with reward. Local APIs/imports are Mathlib.Probability.Kernel.MeasurableIntegral, ProbabilityTheory.Kernel, IsMarkovKernel, MeasureTheory.StronglyMeasurable.integral_kernel, and Bochner integral simplification. The proof route registers the stored Markov witness, applies measurable kernel integration to the continuation value, adds the stored measurable reward, and simplifies the zero integral. Regularity is finite State and Action with supplied measurable spaces, a Markov transition kernel, measurable uncurried reward, and a measurable continuation value only for the measurability theorems; no policy, trajectory, initial law, boundedness, integrability premise, Bellman recursion, optimality, occupancy, or regret is assumed. Retrieval evidence is MLIB-PROBABILITY-KERNEL, MLIB-MEASURE-INTEGRAL, exact local Mathlib MeasurableIntegral declarations, and the finite-horizon RL task/scenario cards. Status is leanCompiled with focused/root/Tests.Basic builds, external canaries, baseline-only axiom audit, placeholder scan, independent review, declaration retrieval, and the full repository gate. Failure policy: preserve this as the data and one-step operator layer; the finite-horizon policy-evaluation Bellman theorem now compiles downstream, but trajectory existence, Bellman optimality, occupancy, and RL regret must not be inferred from this parent leaf.

Compiled finite-horizon Markov policy-evaluation theorem route. A policy stores one Mathlib Markov action kernel for every stage in Fin mdp.horizon. inducedStateKernel composes that action law with the MDP transition by Kernel.compProd and projects the next state by Kernel.map Prod.snd, with its Markov witness proved by Mathlib instances. bellman integrates mdp.bellmanQ against the stage action kernel, and measurable_bellman uses StronglyMeasurable.integral_kernel_prod_right. valueRemaining recursively evaluates decisions remaining with chronological index horizon-remaining; valueAt reindexes by the actual stage. The endpoint valueAt_bellman proves V_t = B_pi_t V_(t+1) for every t<horizon, while valueAt_horizon proves V_H=0 and measurable_valueAt derives every value surface's measurability. The dependent Nat subtraction is transported by valueRemaining_eq_of_eq using proof irrelevance. Regularity is finite State and Action with supplied measurable spaces, the parent Markov transition and measurable deterministic Real reward, and one Markov action kernel per valid stage. No initial law, trajectory, boundedness, caller integrability, deterministic policy, maximization, optimality, occupancy, conditional expectation, or regret is assumed. Retrieval evidence is LOCAL-LEAF-RL-FINITE-HORIZON-MDP-MATHLIB-SURFACE, MLIB-PROBABILITY-KERNEL, MLIB-MEASURE-INTEGRAL, exact Mathlib CompProd/MapComap/MeasurableIntegral APIs, SCN-RL-MDP, and textbook/UCB-VI cards as evidence only. Status is leanCompiled with focused/root/Tests.Basic builds, ten checks, and four external instance/measurability/terminal/Bellman canaries. Failure policy: policy composition, backward policy evaluation, terminal value, chronological Bellman recursion, and recursive measurability are closed. Next prove a generated finite policy trajectory has expected cumulative reward equal to valueAt 0; do not jump to Bellman optimality, occupancy regret, UCB-VI optimism, or episode regret.

Compiled finite-horizon policy-trajectory/value theorem route.     [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (y : ℝ) (z : E) :
    ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ (fun x : E => max (1 - y * inner ℝ z x) 0) ∧
